facts.fact: A joint order of 17 March 2025, gazetted 20 March, declares the whole island of Sao Vicente a cadastred area with compulsory property registration, following the Land project that built a property rights information system and cadastred Sal, Boa Vista, rural Sao Vicente and Maio.
facts.system: cadastro predial and property rights information system
